_what: Recently Deleted and Archived as DATA, read by src/namespace-set-aside.mjs (the owner), src/file-tools.mjs (the AI tools) and src/workspace/set-aside.ts (the Files, Media and Recently Deleted screens). Each state: its id; label (what the person calls it); set_aside_words (said when something goes there); after_days (how many days it keeps things by default; null keeps until put back; the person's own keep-for replaces it); when_due (what it becomes when that time ends: another state's id, or null: its names are gone for good); due_words (the same in words); action_label, icon and tone (the action that puts a file there, on Files and Media). keep_for_choices are the usual numbers of days offered (null: until put back). A new state is one row here and nothing else.
